report:
# Read of unit U1a3, round 2 (follow-up to round 1)

Subject: the worktree on goal/the-deputy-acts-under-a-recorded-delegation against base
f0b16f81ab92dcb3f1a8d4343719c18b94e7cd4f. The worktree diff is identical to the candidate
round-2/worktree.diff: it differs only in abbreviated index hashes, and the candidate's
SHA-256 is 7eeb24a4...ca89. Judged against build brief AM4 and AM6.

## Folds of round 1

- Finding 1 (material: TestMessageGrantAddAtTheHelmIsOneRefusal was not migrated). HOLDS.
  `cmd/metasystem/message_person_test.go:141` and `:147` now pass `--classes ordering`, and the
  expected enrollment refusal is unchanged. I ran it and it passed:
  `--- PASS: TestMessageGrantAddAtTheHelmIsOneRefusal (36.92s)`.
  I also checked the rest of the rule ("every test that records or attempts an unclassed
  general grant"). I searched every `_test.go` for a `grant add --acts everything` call
  without classes. Only one remains, `intent_decision_test.go:755-760`, and it is the
  intended "unclassed" row: it injects an unclassed ledger entry and never runs the
  command. The W5 refusal rows (`intent_grant_everything_test.go:303-310`) all carry
  `--classes ordering`, except the `everything,approve` row, which is refused earlier at
  `intent_grant_everything.go:73`.
  `internal/humanauthority/remedy_test.go:18` only echoes an argv back, and
  `message_audit_test.go:546` is a historical "before" text. Neither is a grant attempt.
- Finding 2 (non-material: the help taught the unclassed form). FOLDED.
  - The usage `intent_planning.go:266`, the flag text `:279` (now built from
    `goal.AttorneyClasses`), the examples `:288` and `grant_everything.go:15` all carry
    `--classes`.
  - New test `TestGrantAddHelpNamesGrantableClasses` checks every `--acts everything` line
    of usage, examples and `grantEndExamples`, and runs each example. It passed.
  - No live doc outside `plans/` teaches the unclassed form; `git grep` found none.
- Finding 3 (non-material: an unclassed live grant was shown as "everything"). FOLDED
  for an entry that carries no grantable class.
  - `intent_grant_everything.go:264-277` and `intent_planning.go:2599-2601` show
    "admits nothing (names no grantable class)" in the status line, the banner,
    `grant list` text and the `coverage` field of `grant list --json`.
  - New test `TestGrantWithNoGrantableClassAdmitsNothingInViews` covers nil classes and
    retired-only classes. It passed.
  - The partial case is observation 1 below.
- Finding 4 (non-material: dead parameters in `attorneyActClass`). Not addressed. It was
  optional and stays optional.

## Tests run

- `go test ./internal/goal/ -count=1 -run 'General|Attorney|Grant|Root|Carries'`: ok.
  This includes the rewritten `TestGrantGeneralRecordsOneGrantPerCheckout`. Each of its
  rows now expects its own refusal text rather than any refusal, so it is stronger than
  before.
- `go test ./cmd/metasystem/ -count=1 -v -run '^(TestMessageGrantAddAtTheHelmIsOneRefusal|TestGrant.*|.*Attorney.*|TestNoGrantProofReachesAPersonOverride|TestAuditOutputLayout.*|TestAuditMessagesAPersonReads|TestAuditMessageRuleCatchesItsTrigger)$'`:
  ok, 27 top-level PASS, no FAIL. The PASS list includes
  TestAuditOutputLayout, TestAuditOutputLayoutJSONUnchanged and TestAuditMessagesAPersonReads,
  so the moved status goldens and the longer help and refusal texts pass both audits.
- An earlier, broader `-run` pattern hit the 10-minute timeout on an unrelated serial test,
  TestIntentCarriedAmbiguousRetainedBaseNeedsReplacement, under host load ~18. No test
  failed in that run. The narrow run above replaces it.

## Material findings

None.

## Non-gating observations

1. A live grant that names both grantable and retired classes still lists the retired
   ones as if they were in force.
   RELATION: same-rule-as 3 (R-143-m1e: the person understands the impact first).
   - Where: `metasystem/cmd/metasystem/intent_grant_everything.go:272-277`.
     `attorneyActs` returns `strings.Join(entry.Classes, ", ")` as soon as one class is
     carried.
   - Effect: a live historical entry naming `acks,mechanical,ordering,recovery,stale-releases`
     (decision 40's rollout set) shows in status and `grant list` as
     "m1e acts for wido in acks, mechanical, ordering, recovery, stale-releases".
     `Carries` refuses mechanical and stale-releases, so admission still fails safe.
   - Related: `grant list --all` now shows a closed historical unclassed grant as
     "admits nothing", which misstates what it admitted while it was in force.
   - Later: list only the classes `Carries` admits, and mark retired ones as retired.
2. The status layout fixture still injects an unclassed entry.
   RELATION: new (rule: a layout golden shows the representative case).
   - Where: `metasystem/cmd/metasystem/audit_output_layout_test.go:203-205`.
   - Effect: `testdata/layout/status*.{txt,json}` now show the degenerate banner
     "wido's grant is live: admits nothing (names no grantable class)" as the live grant.
     No defect: the classed status line is asserted at
     `intent_grant_everything_test.go:124`.
   - Later: give the fixture `Classes: []string{"ordering"}`, as the grant-list fixture
     already has.
3. Size.
   RELATION: new (rule: unit size row).
   - Production lines are 85, within the row's 90.
   - Test lines are about 358, plus 29 golden lines, against the row's 200 for tests; the
     total is 472 against 290.
   - Nothing unsafe follows. The test growth is the AM4 fixture migration and the two
     audit tests.

## Budget

All checklist items were checked within the tool-call budget: item 1 for the round-2
delta and the fold rule, and item 2.

VERDICT: land
